question: Does a time-by-intensity step-wedge design require one shared absolute density/transmittance anchor to identify all four bounded local-reciprocity parameters under scanner-gain nuisance?

controls.unanchored: one independent scanner log-gain per exposure time
controls.global_scalar: one P plus one shared scanner log-gain
controls.wrong_time_order: reverse physical-time labels after observations are frozen

forbidden: treat per-time normalized scans as absolute reciprocity calibration
change parameter bounds, initialization, noise, roles, optimizer or gates after fitting
claim the synthetic truth parameters describe any named film, roll, developer or scanner
render photographs or integrate the mechanism into a profile/product

branch_rule.pass: freeze the shared absolute density/transmittance anchor as a required future acquisition field and retain only the synthetic identifiability result
branch_rule.fail: close the four-parameter representation or measurement design without optimizer or gate rescue

claim_ceiling: Synthetic identifiability and controlled-acquisition design for local-intensity reciprocity; not measured film, roll/process/scanner calibration, photographic quality or product evidence.
